header_sentences: See Jacob, Jew, Judah, Moses, and Tribe.

contexts.text: The spiritual man is here called Israel.
By Israel () is signified intelligence.
When the Internal Church is treated of, it is called Israel.
The Primitive Church, or the Church of the gentiles, is signified by the house of Israel, and the people of Israel.
When Israel is mentioned in the Prophets, there is signified for the most part the Spiritual Church, or whatever is of that Church; where Jacob, the external Church.
By Israel is signified the Internal Spiritual Church. AC 1232. AC 3654:4.
By Israel in the Word is signified the Spiritual Church; and by Judah, the Celestial Church. AC 1069:3. AC 1069:4.
Israel () = the Ancient Church.
Judah = the Celestial Church; Israel, the Spiritual Church; and Jacob, the External Church. AC 1228:2.
So Israel was nothing so little as a spiritual man, but still he represented him; in like manner Jacob.
Israel or the Spiritual Church. Treated of. AC 1186:7. AC 1949:4.
Israel, here, = the perverted Spiritual Church.
Israel = the spiritual things of the Church; Judah = the celestial things of the same.
Jacob, here, = external worship; Israel, internal.
Israel, here, = the Lord. AC 1462:7. AC 3305:2. AC 3305:4.
The seed of Israel = what is celestial of charity.
The dwelling of the sons of Israel in Egypt was reckoned from the sojourn of Abram there, 430 years, AC 2959:2. AC 2959:3.

Before they had kings, the sons of Israel were a nation, and represented good, or the Celestial; but after they wished for a king, and obtained one, they became a people, and represented... truth or the Spiritual...
Judah = the celestial, and Israel the spiritual, in Heaven and on earth.
As all the sons of Israel represented the Lord's heavenly Kingdom... they called one another brethren, and also companions...
Israel = the Spiritual Church. AC 2832:5.
Jacob = the External Church; Israel, the Internal Church.
The journeyings and wanderings of the Israelitish people in the wilderness represented... the vastation and desolation of the faithful before regeneration, consequently their temptation.
That through the Divine Human of the Lord there is the Heavenly Kingdom for the sons of Israel, that is, for the spiritual. Signified.
The seed of Israel = the Spiritual of the Church...
The spiritual man, who is Israel.
Those who worship from the good of faith, which is the house of Israel; and from the good of love, which is the house of Aaron.
The house of Israel = the Spiritual Church as to good. AC 3969:12.
The virgin of Israel = the Spiritual Church.
Israel = spiritual good.
Israel, in the supreme sense, = the Lord as to Divine spiritual love; and in the relative sense, those who are in spiritual love; that is, who are in charity towards the neighbour.
The land and ground of Israel = the Spiritual Church.
The Lord as to the Divine Human is meant in the supreme sense by Israel My servant. Illustrated.
Here, Israel My servant, in the supreme sense, = the Lord relatively to the internal things of the Spiritual Church; and Jacob, as to the external things of that Church. AC 3441:3.
Jacob = those who are in evil; Israel, those who are in falsity.
By Israel, or the Israelitish people, was represented the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom. Illustrated.
Judah = celestial good... and Israel, celestial truth, or spiritual good.

As the Israelitish people represented the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens, and thus the heavenly order there, it was commanded that they should be distinguished according to tribes, and according to families, and according to the houses of their fathers (); and also that they should encamp according to that order... and that they should march according to the like order (); and therefore when Balaam saw Israel dwelling according to his tribes (he blessed him) (), in which prophecy neither Jacob nor Israel is meant, but the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens, and His Church on earth, which were represented by that order...
It here treats of a new Spiritual Church, which is Jacob, and Israel.
Not a whit of this is understood of that nation; but of the Lord's Celestial Kingdom, which is Judah, and of His Spiritual Kingdom, which is Israel.
The land of Israel = the Spiritual Church.
As by Israel is represented the Lord's Spiritual Church, Jacob, then Israel, said to Joseph before his death, Thy two sons... shall be mine... Explained.
(Jacob) was named Israel, by whom is represented the celestial spiritual man.
Unless it is known what is celestial spiritual good, which is Israel; and natural good, which is Jacob...

Thy name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel () = the Divine Celestial Spiritual now. Israel = the celestial spiritual man which is in the Natural, thus the Natural. (Continued. See Celestial Spiritual.)

But, in the supreme sense, Israel = the Lord as to the Divine Celestial Spiritual; and, in the internal sense, he = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom in Heaven and on earth... (and thus) the spiritual man... AC 4297.
That Jacob = one thing, and Israel another. Illustrated.

In general, by Jacob in the Word is signified the external of the Church; and by Israel, the internal; for every Church has an external and an internal... and as that which is of the Church is signified by Jacob and Israel, and as everything of the Church is from the Lord, in the supreme sense the Lord is both Jacob and Israel; Jacob as to the Divine Natural, and Israel as to the Divine Spiritual. Hence the external of the Lord's Kingdom and Church is Jacob, and the internal is Israel. Illustrated.

Whence Jacob was named Israel, is evident from the words themselves when this name was given him... because as a prince thou hast contended with God and with men, and hast prevailed; for Israel in the Original Language means one contending as a prince with God, by which words in the internal sense is signified that he has conquered in the combats of temptations...

It is known that the Church, or the man of the Christian Church, calls himself Israel; but still no one in the Church is Israel except him who has been made a spiritual man through temptations. The very name also involves the same thing.
As Israel = the spiritual celestial man, thus the internal man, Israel also = the Internal Spiritual Church...
This new quality is Israel.

The Internal Spiritual Church was represented by Israel, but the Internal Celestial Church was afterwards represented by Judah. Therefore a division was made, and the Israelites were a kingdom by themselves, and so were the Jews... Hence it is evident that... the descendants of Jacob could not represent the Church as Jacob; for this would have been to represent only the external of the Church; but as Israel in addition, because Israel = what is internal. AC 4292:end.
Therefore the sons of Israel do not eat the sinew of what is put out, which is upon the hollow of the thigh () = that those things in which are falsities are not appropriated.
The reason these things are said of the sons of Israel, is that by Israel is signified the Divine Celestial Spiritual.
And called it El Elohe Israel () = interior worship from the Divine Spiritual. Israel = the Spiritual.
Israel = the Lord as to the Divine Spiritual; and, in the representative sense, the Lord's Spiritual Church; or, what is the same, the man who is such.
For the statutes, judgments, and laws which were given to the Israelitish and Jewish nation were not new; but were such as had been before in the Ancient Church, and in the Second Ancient Church...
Because he had wrought folly in Israel... ()... It is said in Israel, because by Israel is signified the Internal of the Church.
I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel... Israel = the Internal of the Church.
It treats in () of the... interiors of the Natural, that they were made Divine, (and which) here, are Israel.
Because Israel = the Lord's internal Divine Natural.

But Israel shall be thy name () = the quality of the internal Natural, or the quality of its Spiritual which is Israel. And He called his name Israel = the internal Natural, or the Celestial Spiritual of the Natural... (for) Israel = the internal of the Lord's Natural.
No one can know why Jacob was called Israel except him who knows what the internal Natural is, and what the external Natural; and also what the Celestial Spiritual of the Natural is. Fully Explained.
It is this internal Natural which Israel in special represents.

As the Lord's Church is external and internal, and the internals of the Church had to be represented by the externals by the descendants of Jacob, therefore Jacob could no longer be called Jacob, but Israel.
In the supreme sense, that Jacob was called Israel = that the Lord, having advanced to interior things, made the Natural in Himself Divine, as to both its external and its internal. AC 4585:4.

Jacob represented the man of the Church as to his External, and Israel, as to his Internal; thus Jacob, as to his exterior Natural, and Israel, as to his interior Natural... For the spiritual man is from the Natural, but the celestial man is from the Rational.
This Intermediate derives something from the internal of the Natural, which is Israel; and from the external of the Rational, which is Joseph. AC 4592:2.

There are six names which frequently occur in the propheticals when the Church is being treated of; namely, Judah, Joseph, Benjamin, Ephraim, Israel, and Jacob... Israel = the spiritual Internal, and Jacob, the spiritual External.
Israel journeyed () = the Celestial Spiritual of the Natural now... The Celestial Spiritual of the Natural... is the good of truth, or the good of charity acquired through the truth of faith.
As the progression of the Lord's Divine towards interior things is treated of, Jacob is here called Israel.
It came to pass in the residing of Israel in this land () = when in this state of good from truth.

Israel heard it () = that that faith was rejected. In the proper sense, that Israel heard it = that the Spiritual Church knew and assented to this... But in the internal sense it = that that faith was rejected.

Israel loved Joseph more than all his sons () = the conjunction of the Divine Spiritual of the Rational with the Divine Spiritual of the Natural. (For) Jacob as Israel represents the Divine Spiritual of the Natural, or the Celestial of the Spiritual from the Natural.
By Israel, in the opposite sense, are represented those who are in the love of the world...
For by Israel was represented the Lord's royalty.
The rest of the tribes were called in one word Israelites; for Israel, in the representative sense, = the spiritual man; and, in the universal sense, the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom.

In the historical sense... by Israel are meant the ten tribes... But in the internal or spiritual sense... by Israel is represented the Spiritual of the Church, or truth; and, in the opposite sense... by Israel is represented falsity... whether with the Jews or with the Israelites.
(Therefore) he was called Israel, and by this name he represented the good of truth; for, in the representative sense, Israel = the good which comes through truth.
The extirpation of the truth of the External and Internal Church is signified by to give Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches ().
Israel = the Spiritual Church.
Israel = the Spiritual Ancient Church at its beginning.
Israel = the Spiritual of the Church. AC 5354:8.

The sons of Israel came to buy in the midst of those who came () = that he wanted spiritual truths to be procured through scientifics, like the rest... The sons of Israel = spiritual truths in the Natural.
That good of truth which is represented by Jacob is the good of the External Church; but that which is represented by Israel is relatively of the Internal Church.
The house of Jacob = the External Church; the house of Israel, the Internal Church.
Israel = the good of spiritual truth.

And Israel said () = perception from spiritual good... As Israel = spiritual good, he = also the Internal Spiritual Church; for this Church is the Church from spiritual good. AC 5599. AC 5603. AC 5616. AC 5678. AC 5680. AC 5801.
Israel = the Internal of the Church.
Israel = the Church. AC 5632.
For Israel represented the Lord as to the interior Natural...
Israel represents the Spiritual Church, and indeed its Internal, which is the good of truth, or spiritual good from the Natural. AC 5807. AC 5817. AC 5825.
When a man has come to good through truth, he is then Israel...

Between the representation of Joseph, which is internal good, and the representation of Israel, which is spiritual good, there is this difference: Joseph = internal good from the Rational, and Israel = internal good from the Natural; which is a difference such as there is between celestial good or the good of the Celestial Church, and spiritual good or the good of the Spiritual Church.
In the interior Natural is the spiritual good which is Israel, and in the exterior Natural are the truths of the Church, which are the sons of Jacob.
The spiritual good which Israel represents is the good of truth, that is, truth in will and act. This truth, or good of truth, effects with man that he is the Church...
The reason Israel = the Church, is that spiritual good, which he represents makes the Church with a man... Hence it is that in the Word, especially the prophetical one, Israel = the Spiritual Church.

In () it treats of the internal man, that he conjoined himself with the external Natural; but as there is no conjunction with this except by means of spiritual good from the Natural, which is Israel, he therefore prepares to adjoin this to himself first. AC 5879.
For the sons of Israeli spiritual truths in the Natural. AC 5951. AC 6040. AC 6437. AC 6567.
The land of Israel = the Spiritual Church.

It is from this progression, or birth, that the External is called the father of the Internal; consequently, spiritual good from the Natural, which is Israel, is called the father of the celestial Internal, which is Joseph.
Israel = spiritual good. AC 5941. AC 5947. AC 5973. Illustrated. AC 5997. AC 6253. AC 6265:2. AC 6447.
Israel = spiritual good from the Natural. References.

Israel journeyed, and all that he had () = the beginning of conjunction... here, what is continuous and successive in the glorification of the Lord, who, in the supreme sense, is Israel and Joseph; but in the internal sense, what is continuous and successive in the regeneration of man...
The sons of Israel bore Jacob their father () = that the truths which are spiritual put forward natural truth.
(Joseph) went up to meet Israel his father () = influx from the Celestial Internal into spiritual good from the Natural.
And Israel said unto Joseph () = the perception of spiritual good from the Celestial Internal.
By Israel () is described the Spiritual in the Lord's Kingdom; by Asshur, the Rational; and by Egypt, the Scientific.
It treats, finally (in ) of the regeneration of spiritual good from the Natural, which is Israel.
Israel = spiritual good in the Natural. References. AC 6350.
Israel = spiritual good from the Natural. AC 6287. AC 6434.
Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt () = that spiritual good was living among the scientifics of the Church.
There approached the days of Israel for dying () = the state just before regeneration... Israel = spiritual good.

They who are in this state are in the Internal Church... and are represented by Israel. These things have been said in order that Jacob may be Israel, and that thus by him as Israel may be represented the spiritual good which is in the interior Natural, and thus the Internal Spiritual Church.

Israel strengthened himself () = new forces through spiritual good... Israel = spiritual good from the Natural... Israel also = the Internal of the Church... In the Internal of the Church are they who are in the good of charity, which is the good of faith, also the good of truth, and also spiritual good, which are Israel. AC 6230:end.
The spiritual good which is represented by Israel is in the interior Natural; for it is the spiritual who are represented by Israel. AC 6256.

Israel put his right hand on the head of Ephraim ()... By this is signified that he accounted the truth of faith as in the first place... because the spiritual man, who is represented by Israel, accounts it no otherwise before he has been regenerated...

Israel = spiritual good from the Natural... and as this good which Israel represents is the good of truth, therefore it is here said the good of spiritual truth; for, in the genuine sense, Israel = the Spiritual Church, and the good which is of that Church is the good of truth... AC 6499.
Israel = the good of spiritual truth from the Natural.
The spiritual, who are represented by Israel, are in obscurity relatively to the celestial.
The Internal of the Spiritual Church is what is represented by Israel; and the External by Ephraim.
That the Spiritual, which is Israel, may be in them. Signified.
Spiritual good, which is represented by Israel, is the Spiritual of the Internal Church; whereas the truth and good which are represented by Ephraim and Manasseh are of the External Church.
Israel said to Joseph, Lo I die () = the perception of spiritual good from the Celestial Internal concerning new life.
The sons of Israel and their descendants... represented the Lord's Celestial and Spiritual Kingdom... With the Israelitish people was the representative of the Spiritual Kingdom...
Listen to Israel your father () = prediction concerning these things by spiritual good; in the supreme sense, the Lord's foresight.
I will scatter them in Israel () = that they are to be exterminated from the spiritual man.
The sons of Israel = spiritual truths, References.
That Israel, in the supreme sense, = the Lord. Illustrated.

Therefore, by Israel is signified the Spiritual Church; and, in a higher sense, the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom. (Thus) by from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel () is signified that thence are all good and truth for the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom.
The sons of Israel and the tribes named from them... = the goods and truths in the Natural.

As it here treats of the gathering together or manifestation of spiritual good, which is Israel, in the goods and truths of the Natural, which are his sons or the tribes named from them, it shall be stated how this is to be understood...

For the spiritual good, which is Israel, is in the interior of the Natural; and the goods and truths, which are his sons, are in the exterior of it. That in these there must be spiritual good, is signified by,I am being gathered to my people. AC 6464. AC 6465.
As by Israel is represented spiritual good from the Natural, and by Jacob spiritual truth in the Natural, and by his sons goods and truths in the Natural distinct in genera, a bed is mentioned...
Israel = the good of the Spiritual Church.

The sons of Israel, who are here the brethren of Joseph = spiritual truths, (References.) which truths are also from the Celestial Internal, which is Joseph, but through spiritual good, which is Israel.
For the Israelites, who were at Samaria, represented the Spiritual Church.
The sons of Israel = the truths of faith in the complex.
Israel = the Spiritual Church.
They who are signified by the sons of Israel, who are all those of the Spiritual Church, both those who have been, and those who are to come.
That the Israelitish and Jewish people was not a Church, but only a representative of the Church. References.
These are the names of the sons of Israel () = the quality of the Church.

As Israel represents the good of truth or spiritual good, and his sons spiritual truths in the Natural, therefore the sons of Israel represent the Church; for the Church is the Church from spiritual good and from the truths thence...
This then is the Church which is meant by the sons of Israel here and in what follows.
These are the things which are represented by Pharaoh and the Egyptians afflicting the sons of Israel... AC 6657:3.

These are the things which are described... by the sons of Israel, in that they were oppressed by the Egyptians, and were afterwards delivered, and at last, after various states in the wilderness, were introduced into the Land of Canaan.
The sons of Israel were fruitful and productive () = that the truths of the Church grew as to good. The sons of Israel = spiritual truths; and the Church. References.

Behold, the people of the sons of Israel are many and numerous above us () = that the truths of the Church prevail over alienated scientifics... The sons of Israel = the truths and goods of the Church.
The Egyptians made the sons of Israel serve () = the striving to subjugate... The sons of Israel = the Church.
The house of Israel = the Church which is to be formed.

Lest, therefore, the representatives and significatives of the Church should be further turned into magic, the Israelitish people was taken, with whom the representatives and significatives of the Chm-ch were restored...
The sons of Israel sighed from the service () = grief on account of the endeavour to subjugate the truth of the Church... The sons of Israel = the truths of the Church.
The cry of the sons of Israel has come to Me () = compassion for those who are of the Spiritual Church.
Lead My people the sons of Israel out of Egypt () = the deliverance thence of those who are of the Spiritual Church from infesting falsities. AC 6868.
The sons of Israel = those who are of the Spiritual Church. AC 6881. AC 6914. AC 6944. AC 7008. AC 7062. AC 7221. AC 7316. AC 7349. AC 7393. AC 8787. AC 8830.
The sons of Israel = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom, and thence the Spiritual Church.

Thus saith Jehovah the God of Israel () = from the Lord's Divine Human... He is called the God of Israel because by Israel is signified the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom; and because the Lord by His Advent into the world saved those who are of that Kingdom or Church.
Hence it is that by the God of Israel is meant the Lord as to... the Divine Natural... Israel = the Lord as to the internal Divine Natural...
That the Lord as to the Divine Natural is meant by the God of Israel. Illustrated.
That the God of Israel, and the Holy One of Israel = the Lord as to the Divine Human. Illustrated.
That the Lord has saved Israel, that is, those who are of the Spiritual Church. Illustrated.

The things of faith and charity are signified by the sons of Israel, of whom it is said that they would be killed; for the essentials of the Spiritual Church, which is signified by the sons of Israel, are charity and faith.
The sons of Israel, who are here the people, = those who are of the Spiritual Church, thus who are in the truths of the Church, and in its goods.
Say to the sons of Israel () = that the Divine Law shall give those of the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom to apperceive.
Moses spake thus to the sons of Israel () = exhortation by the Divine Law to those who are of the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom.
The sons of Israel have not listened to me () = that the spiritual have not received the things which have been announced to them.
He gave them a charge to the sons of Israel () = concerning the command to those who are of the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom.

Lead out the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt () = that those of the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom should be delivered from the propinquity of those who are in falsities. AC 7238. AC 7271. AC 7277. AC 7282.
Hence it is that miracles were performed with the Israelitish and Jewish people, for they were solely in external worship... AC 7290:3.

Therefore the sons of Israel were led down into the wilderness, in order that they might represent that state in which were those of the Spiritual Church before the Lord's Advent; and also that state in which are those of the Church at this day, and who are being vastated as to falsities.
The Jews and Israelites believed that there are many gods, but that Jehovah was greater than the rest, on account of the miracles.

The reason the sons of Israel were called the people of Jehovah, was not that they were better than other nations, but because they represented the people of Jehovah, that is, those who are of the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom...
(Thus) the Israelites and Jews were not chosen at all, but were merely accepted to represent the things which are of Heaven.

As to the Spiritual Church, which is here represented by the sons of Israel, it is to be known that it is internal and external; and that those are in the Internal Church who are in the good of charity; and that those are in the External Church who are in the good of faith... These latter are they who are here properly represented by the sons of Israel; for these are they who in the other life are infested by those who are in falsities.

Jehovah will distinguish between the cattle of Israel, and the cattle of the Egyptians () = the difference between the truths and goods of faith of those who are of the Spiritual Church, and the truths and goods of faith of those who infest. AC 7507. AC 7512. AC 7513.
Only in the land of Goshen, where the sons of Israel were, was there no hail () = that there was no (falsity from evils) where were those of the Spiritual Church.
He would not let the sons of Israel go () = that they did not leave them... The sons of Israel = those of the Spiritual Church, whom they were infesting. AC 7707. AC 7798.
All the sons of Israel had light in their dwellings () = that those of the Spiritual Church had enlightenment in their minds everywhere.
To all the sons of Israel shall not a dog move its tongue () = that with those of the Spiritual Church there shall not be the least of damnation and lamentation.
That ye may know that Jehovah discerneth between the Egyptians and Israel () = that the quality of the difference between those who are in evil and those who are in good may be known. Explained.
Speak ye to all the assembly of Israel, saying () = influx with information to all who are of the Spiritual Church.

The assembly of Israel = all truths and goods in the complex; for by the assembly of Israel are meant all the tribes, which = all things of truth and good... (thus also) those of the Spiritual Church.
They shall kill it, all the congregation of the assembly of Israel () = preparation for enjoyment by all in general who are of the Spiritual Church.
That soul shall be cut off from Israel () = that it shall be separated from those of the Spiritual Church, and shall be condemned.
Moses called all the elders of Israel () = the enlightenment of the understanding of those of the Spiritual Church through the influx and presence of truth Divine... Israel = the Spiritual Church.
For that He passed by the houses of the sons of Israel () = that damnation fled away from the goods in which (those of the Spiritual Church) were held by the Lord.
The sons of Israel went and did as Jehovah commanded to Moses and Aaron () = that those of the Spiritual Church will obey truth Divine.
Also the sons of Israel () = ... with truth from good. Explained.
The sons of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth () = the first state of departure.
The journeyings of the sons of Israel, treated of in Exodus, = the states of life and their changes from first to last.
To all the sons of Israel to their generations () = those of the Spiritual Church, with whom there is good from truth and truth from good.

All the assembly of Israel shall do it () = that this is a law of order for all who are in the good of truth and in the truth of good. The assembly of Israel = all truths and goods in one complex; thus those who are in the truth through which is good, and in the good through which is truth; consequently, those of the Spiritual Church.
Jehovah brought out the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt () = that the Lord delivered from damnation those who are in the good of truth and truth of good.
In the sons of Israel () = in the Spiritual Church.
These things are represented by the sons of Israel, in that they were not immediately introduced into the Land of Canaan, but were first in the wilderness...
This is represented by the passage of the sons of Israel through the sea Suph...
The sons of Israel went up girded out of the land of Egypt () = that they were taken out from the state of infestations, and were thus prepared to endure temptations.
Those of the Spiritual Church are represented (in ) by the sons of Israel.
Speak to the sons of Israel () = the influx of truth Divine with those of the Spiritual Church. AC 8180.
Pharaoh will say concerning the sons of Israel () = the thought of those who are in damnation concerning those of the Spiritual Church.
He pursued after the sons of Israel () = an endeavour to subjugate those who are in faith conjoined with charity. Explained.
The sons of Israel went out with a lofty hand () = when yet they were taken out by Divine power from their endeavour to subjugate. Explained.

These things have been said in order that it may be known that by the life of the sons of Israel in the wilderness are described the temptations in their series which those have undergone who have been of the Lord's Spiritual Church and have been delivered...
Let the sons of Israel come into the midst of the sea in the dry () = that those of the Spiritual Church may pass through Hell safely and without the influx of falsity. AC 8205. AC 8234.
Marching before the camp of Israel () = which are near the truths and goods of the Church. Explained.

And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel () = between the falsities of evil on the one side and the goods of truth on the other... The camp of Israel = the goods of truth, because by Israel are signified the truths which are from good.
I will flee before Israel () = separation from those who are in the good of truth and truth of good.
Jehovah saved Israel in this day from the hand of the Egyptians () = that in this state the Lord protected those of the Spiritual Church from all violence by falsities from evil. AC 8237. AC 8238.
Then sang Moses and the sons of Israel this song to Jehovah () = the glorification of the Lord by those of the Spiritual Church on account of the deliverance. Explained.

Those who were set over others in Israel were called princes, because by Israel were represented those who are in the truth and good of faith; but in Judah they were called leaders, because by Judah were represented those who are in the good of love. Illustrated.

Moses made Israel journey from the sea Suph () = what is successive according to the order of truth Divine, after they had passed through the region of Hell... Israel represents those of the Spiritual Church who were detained in the Lower Earth up to the Advent of the Lord, and were then delivered. References.
Say to all the assembly of the sons of Israel () = the instruction (of those of the Spiritual Church).
The former state (of regeneration) was represented by the journeyings of the sons of Israel in the wilderness for forty years; and the latter state by the introduction of them into Canaan.
All the assembly of the sons of Israel journeyed () = what is progressive of spiritual life... The assembly of the sons of Israel = those who are of the Spiritual Church.
The religiosity with the Israelitish nation. Treated of. This nation is described such as it was before Jehovah...
The genius of this nation above every other nation was to worship external things... and as it could thus act the representative of the Church, it was therefore taken. Explained.
Israel prevailed () = that then truth combating conquered... Israel = those of the Spiritual Church; here, those who combat from truths against falsities from interior evil.

Israel, who here is Moses and the people ... = those of the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom. References. For Moses together with the people represents this Kingdom; Moses as the head, and the people as the things which are subject to the head...
That Jehovah had brought Israel forth out of Egypt () = that (those of the Spiritual Kingdom) had been delivered by the Lord from infestations. AC 8751.
For Israel's sakes () = for those of the Spiritual Church.
Israel = those of the Spiritual Church. AC 8685.
Aaron came and all the elders of Israel () = which were the primary things of the Church.
Moses chose men of activity from all Israel () = choice of truths to which good could be adjoined with those of the Spiritual Church.
Israel encamped near the mountain () = a disposing with those of the Spiritual Church by Divine celestial good.
Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell to the sons of Israel () = the salvation of those of the External and Internal Spiritual Church.

As the representative of the Celestial Kingdom began to perish when they asked for a king, therefore, in order that the representative of the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens might be continued, the Jews were separated from the Israelites; and by the Jewish kingdom was represented the Lord's Celestial Kingdom, and by the Israelitish kingdom His Spiritual Kingdom.
These are the words which thou shalt speak to the sons of Israel () = influx for the reception of truths in good. Explained.
In order that the Israelitish people might be able to represent... their interiors were veiled over. Signified, Explained.
Israel... = those in spiritual good in which truth is to be implanted. Treated of.
The sons of Israel = those of the Spiritual Church, thus those who are in truth through which is good, and in good from which is truth; here, in the good into which truths are to be received.
By the people Israel near Mount Sinai is represented the Spiritual Church as to good, in which the truths of faith are to be implanted... This state is an intermediate state (of regeneration).
Marriages with the Israelitish nation were impure, because their interiors were filthy. Explained.
The obscurity in which was the Israelitish nation. Representation.
The sons of Israel = those of the Spiritual Kingdom.
(Idolatry) was so severely interdicted with the Israelitish nation, because the adoration of other gods... destroyed the representative of the Church with them...
Under Sabbath, see this reference.
Israel = those who are in the Internal of the Church.
That that nation was very remote from internal things. Representation.
Character of the Israelitish and Jewish people. References. AC 8932:2. References.
Thus shalt thou say to the sons of Israel () = those of the Spiritual Church.

The twelve sons of Israel, or the twelve tribes, represented and thence signified the Church as to all truths and goods. References.
Israel is the staff of His inheritance () = the Church in which is Divine truth and its power against falsities.

Israel = the Internal Church; and as the internal of the Church is founded upon its externals, and the internals are thence multiplied and fructified, it is said that Jacob shall root those that are to come, and that Israel shall effloresce and flourish ().
Israel, in the supreme sense, = the Lord as to the Internal Church.
Israel = the Church with those who are interiorly natural, and are in truths there from a spiritual origin. Therefore by Israel is signified the Spiritual Natural Church.
The seed of Israel = those who are in Divine truths.
Israel = the Church which is in truths from good.
The sons of Israel and the sons of Judah... () = the nations who are in truths and goods from the Lord.
Those who are of the External Church are meant by Jacob; and those who are of the Internal Church by Israel (); and by the latter and the former are meant the nations (or gentiles).
The sons of Israel = the gentiles.
An Israelite (Nathanael) () = him who is in the good of charity, and from this in truths, thus who is in truths from good.
The remains of Israel = those who are in spiritual faith, because in the good of charity...
The spiritual man is here signified by the sons of Israel (in Egypt).
The good of charity is signified by the mountain of the height of Israel.

Judah and the sons of Israel his companions () = the Lord's Celestial Kingdom; Judah, that Kingdom as to good; and the sons of Israel, that Kingdom as to truth. But Joseph and the tribes of Israel his companions = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom; Joseph, that Kingdom as to good; and the tribes of Israel his companions, that Kingdom as to truth.
The third Church (on this Earth) was the Israelitish.

Hence it was that the men of the Ancient Church, and still more the men of the Israelitish Church, were external and natural men; nor could they become internal and spiritual men, as could the men after the Lord's Advent. But still those who acknowledged Jehovah, and together with Him Adonai, that is, the Lord to come... and who worshipped them together, received what is holy in their spirits, and thence in the typical things of their religion. But the rest did not receive it, whence their religion was... a superstition, and their worship was not representative, but idolatrous. Explained.
After these instructions, the sons of Israel were intromitted into the Land of Canaan, consequently into the Church itself...
That the third state of this Church was its decline from true representative worship into idolatrous worship, and its vastation or evening then. Explained.

That the fourth state of this Church was the profanation of holy things, and its consummation or night then. Explained.
